items.answer: Owing to the financial crisis, millions of people were living on the verge of starvation.

items.question: 一个民族必须掌握自己的命运，而不应任凭命运的摆布。(at the mercy of)
items.answer: A nation must be masters of themselves instead of living at the mercy of fate.

items.question: 我们不应以损坏环境为代价来发展经济。(at the expense of)
items.answer: We shouldn’t promote economic growth at the expense of the environment.

items.question: 我们学校的大门向所有的人敞开，不管什么种族，肤色和信仰。(irrespective of)
items.answer: Our schools are open to all irrespective of race, color or creed.

items.question: 不管花多少钱，她都要买一辆豪华车。(regardless of)
items.answer: She is bent on buying an expensive car regardless of the cost.

items.question: 我们必须秉承自力更生的原则来发展经济。(in line with)
items.answer: We must develop our economy in the line with the principle of self-reliance.

items.question: 我们不可以借口发展工业而污染环境。(on/under the pretence of)
items.answer: We must not contaminate the environment on the pretence of developing industry.

items.question: 我的邻居老汤姆孑身独处，只有一条名叫 Boris 的大黑狗和一只名叫 Blackie 的大黑猫和他做伴。(apart from)
items.answer: My neighbor Old Tom lived entirely alone, apart from a big black cat named Blackie and a big black dog called Boris.

items.question: 在 1937 年卢沟桥事变发生以前，中国的东北三省已被日本占领了 6 年。(previous to)
items.answer: Previous to the Lugou Bridge Incident in 1937, China’s three northeastern provinces had been under the Japanese occupation for 6 years.

items.question: 那将军相信他所做的一切都是为了中国人民的利益。(in the interests of)
items.answer: The general believed that all he did was in the interests of the Chinese people.

items.question: 我们必须随时提防敌人的破坏活动。(on the watch for)
items.answer: We must always be on the watch for the enemy’s subversive activities.

items.question: 在警察方面仍然心存疑虑。(on the part of)
items.answer: There were still doubts on the part of the police.

items.question: 由于金融危机，该国的经济已处于破产的边缘。(on the brink of)
items.answer: Owing to the financial crisis, that country’s economy was on the brink of bankruptcy.

items.question: 如果发生金融危机，一般老百姓将饱尝失业和通胀之苦。(in the event of)
items.answer: In the event of a financial crisis, the common people will suffer from inflation and unemployment.

items.question: 那船正顶着狂风全速行驶。(in the teeth of)
items.answer: The ship was sailing full steam in the teeth of a strong wind.

items.answer: He decided to retire ahead of time on the ground of ill health.

items.answer: If I can get a loan from the bank, I'll buy the house.

items.answer: His health won't improve unless he gives up smoking at once.

items.answer: I wouldn't buy this picture even if I could afford it.

items.answer: If there weren't so many mosquitoes, it would be a perfect evening.

items.answer: What would you do about the problem if you were in my shoes?

items.answer: If he president hadn't violated the Federal law, he wouldn't have been forced to resign.

items.answer: If the shop had packed the goods properly, they wouldn't have got damaged.

items.answer: If it had not been for the stabilizing effect of the Renminbi, the financial crisis in East Asia would have worsened.

items.question: 如果当初你采纳我的劝告，你现在就不会陷入这样的困境。
items.answer: If you had taken my advice, you would not be in a difficult position now.

items.answer: If I knew her address, I would have sooner written to her.

items.answer: If I were her, I would never have accepted their invitation.

items.question: 要不是因为总统行为失检，他就不会被弹劾。
